compatibilityPolicies.stable: Stable API under SemVer from 1.0.0. Unions and literal sets are open: adding a value is minor; consumers must keep a default branch for unknown values. Removing, renaming or narrowing an export, value or type is major. Symbols tagged @experimental within a stable subpath are outside this promise.
compatibilityPolicies.experimental: Experimental API; may change in any minor release.
compatibilityPolicies.testing: Test support only; not a runtime compatibility promise.

packageSmokeEvidence.meaning: Hermetic build, import, pack and directory publish-refusal proof for this package.

conformanceEvidence.meaning: A framework-free port/adapter suite is required only when this package declares that seam.

dogfoodEvidence.meaning: A first-party production deployment consumes package seams; this is first-party evidence only.

externalConsumerEvidence.meaning: A first-party demo store installed from npm and a first-party production deployment provide consumer evidence. No independent adoption is claimed.
